svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.21 MASONRY AND CONCRETE CHIMNEYS AND FLUES

g.text: Liner ends not less than 50 mm and not

svg.text: Chimney liners extend from a point not less
than 200 mm (7⅞″) below the lowest flue pipe
connection to a point not less than 50 mm (1
Drawn: chimney cut in half through the flue, liner tinted clay, the 200 mm measured from the underside of the flue pipe. Sizes are illustration only.
